text: It is of the greatest important in this world that a man should know himself, and the measure of his own strength and means; and he who knows that he has not a genius for fighting must learn how to govern by the arts of peace.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
speaker: Castruccio Castracani
locator: The Life of Castruccio Castracani of Lucca
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
